voice_persona: clear, efficient, plain-spoken — a colleague walking a new staff member through a workflow, not a sales pitch

lines.text: From the admin panel to the storefront — here's the full life of a product category.
Wedding Invitations — a new category, named in one step.
A short description tells customers what makes it special — premium cardstock, foil, letterpress.
One photo is all it takes to publish.
Renaming it later never breaks its storefront link — the slug stays exactly as it was.
And within moments, it's live on the storefront.
Same name, same description — exactly what was just created in the admin panel.
One workflow, from the back office to the storefront customers see.
